description: 为 SkillHub 接入企业内部 UASS 回跳登录，采用本地 Session 作为浏览器主登录态，兼容 Redis 高可用与单机本地状态存储，并将本次 feature 相关 Java 生产代码行覆盖率提升到 100%。

userStories.title: 新增 UASS 适配层
userStories.description: 作为开发者，我需要一个独立的 UASS 适配层，以便 SkillHub 只依赖统一接口而不直接耦合企业内部 jar 的实现细节。
acceptanceCriteria: Add UassClientFacade in the auth module to wrap login URL building, login validation, status check, user profile lookup, and logout
Keep the internal UASS jar dependency isolated to the auth module or a dedicated integration package
Do not expose raw jar types from UassClientFacade to application services
Add unit tests for successful and failure branches of the facade
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: 新增 UASS 配置与状态存储抽象
userStories.description: 作为开发者，我需要统一的 UASS 配置和 state 存储抽象，以便同一套登录流程可以同时支持 Redis 高可用模式和单机本地模式。
acceptanceCriteria: Add UassProperties with enabled, baseUrl, clientId, clientSecret, callbackPath, stateTtl, and cacheMode configuration fields
Add UassLoginStateStore abstraction with Redis and Local implementations
Persist login state under uass:state:{state} in Redis mode and an in-memory TTL store in local mode
Consume or delete stored state after callback success or failure
Add unit tests for Redis and Local state store implementations, including TTL expiry and cleanup
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: 基于 user_code 的本地用户查找与自动创建
userStories.description: 作为平台管理员，我希望统一登录平台返回的 user_code 成为本地用户匹配主键，以便首次登录时自动建档，后续登录时稳定命中同一用户。
acceptanceCriteria: Map the UASS user identity so that subject is derived from user_code
On callback, look up the local user or identity binding by user_code before establishing the SkillHub session
If no local user exists for user_code, create a new local user from the returned UASS profile and continue the same login flow
Fail the login flow cleanly if user_code is missing or local user creation fails, without leaving a partial session behind
Add unit tests for existing-user, first-login auto-create, disabled-user, pending-user, missing-user_code, and create-failure branches
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: 实现 UASS 登录回调并建立 SkillHub Session
userStories.description: 作为企业用户，我希望从 UASS 统一登录页回跳后自动进入 SkillHub 已登录状态，以便无需二次登录即可访问平台。
acceptanceCriteria: Add endpoints for GET /api/v1/auth/uass/login-url, GET /api/v1/auth/uass/redirect, and GET /api/v1/auth/uass/callback
Generate a state value before redirecting to UASS and store returnTo context for callback recovery
Validate callback state and UASS login result before creating the SkillHub session
After successful callback, establish the local SkillHub session through PlatformSessionService and redirect to the expected returnTo path
If callback validation fails, do not create a session and return a clear failure outcome
Use agent-browser to open /login, trigger enterprise login entry, verify the redirect starts, and verify the callback success path returns to the intended page in a controllable local/test setup
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: 实现登录状态检查与统一登出
userStories.description: 作为企业用户和前端调用方，我希望系统能检查当前登录状态并支持统一登出，以便后续访问行为清晰且安全。
acceptanceCriteria: Add GET /api/v1/auth/uass/status and POST /api/v1/auth/uass/logout
Return login status based on the local SkillHub session by default
If the UASS jar supports remote post-login status checks, keep that check optional and do not make it the primary source of truth
On logout, attempt UASS logout first, then always clear local Session and stored login state even if remote logout fails
Use agent-browser to verify that an authenticated browser session is redirected back to login after logout and protected navigation requires login again
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Do not introduce token refresh or token lifecycle semantics into status handling.

userStories.title: 接入安全路由与前端登录入口
userStories.description: 作为用户，我希望新的企业登录入口自然出现在现有登录页中，并遵守现有的路由放行与鉴权规则。
acceptanceCriteria: Permit anonymous access to /api/v1/auth/uass/login-url, /api/v1/auth/uass/redirect, /api/v1/auth/uass/callback, and /api/v1/auth/uass/status in RouteSecurityPolicyRegistry
Require authentication for /api/v1/auth/uass/logout
Add an enterprise login entry to web/src/pages/login.tsx without breaking existing password and OAuth flows
Preserve returnTo behavior when initiating enterprise login from the login page
Use agent-browser to open /login and confirm the enterprise login entry is visible and does not break the existing password/OAuth tabs
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Follow existing AuthController and login-page patterns.

userStories.title: 支持 Redis 与本地双运行模式
userStories.description: 作为运维和测试人员，我希望同一套 UASS 登录能力既能支撑生产高可用部署，也能在无 Redis 的单机测试环境中运行。
acceptanceCriteria: Support cacheMode=redis, local, and auto for UASS login state storage
In Redis mode, state storage must work across backend replicas without relying on sticky sessions
In local mode, the login flow must still complete successfully in a single-node environment without Redis
Emit a clear runtime log or equivalent signal when running in non-HA local state mode
Add unit and integration tests that cover redis/local/auto behavior and Redis-unavailable fallback
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Keep runtime-mode switching in configuration/assembly layers, not scattered in business logic.

userStories.title: 补齐 UASS feature 范围 Java 覆盖率到 100%
userStories.description: 作为维护者，我希望本次 UASS feature 相关 Java 生产代码全部达到 100% line coverage，以便认证主链路改造具有充分的回归保护。
acceptanceCriteria: Generate a JaCoCo line coverage baseline for all newly added and materially modified Java production classes in this feature
Bring line_missed to 0 for the feature-scope Java production classes, including config, facade, state store, service, controller, mapper, and modified auth/session helper classes
Add or update tests for PlatformSessionService, AuthContextFilter, and RouteSecurityPolicyRegistry if they gain new behavior for this feature
Add a build gate so the feature-scope Java coverage requirement fails the build when not satisfied
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: This story is about the UASS feature scope, not a whole-repo 100% campaign.

userStories.title: 完成浏览器闭环与最终验证
userStories.description: 作为交付负责人，我希望在最终合并前验证完整浏览器闭环和关键构建命令，以便确认功能、质量门禁和运行模式都已达标。
acceptanceCriteria: Use agent-browser to verify the browser flow: open /login, trigger enterprise login entry, complete or simulate callback success in the intended environment, land on the protected target page, refresh, and confirm the user remains logged in
Use agent-browser to verify logout returns the browser to a logged-out state and protected navigation requires login again
Run make test-backend-app successfully
Run make test-frontend successfully
Run make typecheck-web successfully
Run make lint-web successfully
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: This is the final integration validation story that closes the shared feature branch work.
